categories.main_business_segments: The company operates across multiple business segments including aircraft equipment manufacturing (58.53% of revenue), aviation maintenance services (21.51% of revenue), test control and support equipment development (13.99% of revenue), and emerging areas such as intelligent equipment development and industrial software. The company serves the aerospace and defense industry with system and equipment-level products and solutions across the full lifecycle of aircraft.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs integrated product development (IPD) methodology for research and development, with core technologies including 95% crash survival seat technology, dynamic simulation, human factors engineering, and software-defined radio techniques. Manufacturing focuses on total assembly, system integration, testing and verification, airworthiness certification, and critical process manufacturing. The company utilizes platform-based product development strategy with modularization and standardization approaches.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include aircraft manufacturers, system development and production units, aviation operators, and civil aviation transport enterprises. The company serves both defense and civil aviation markets, with major customers including domestic aircraft manufacturers and various aviation operators. The top five customers account for 77.52% of annual sales, indicating concentration in key strategic accounts.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with major presence in Beijing and Tianjin regions. Geographic revenue distribution shows North China (42.22%), East China (17.58%), Northeast China (15.95%), South China (11.01%), Northwest China (9.76%), Southwest China (3.01%), and Central China (0.47%). The company is expanding with new facilities in Tianjin.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates as a Tier 1 and Tier 2 supplier in the aerospace supply chain, positioned at the system equipment and component manufacturing levels. The company serves aircraft manufacturers and aviation operators, with strong emphasis on controlling critical materials through upstream integration, including composite material manufacturing capabilities.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing aircraft cabin equipment nationalization, developing eVTOL (electric vertical takeoff and landing) products, expanding helicopter training systems, and developing intelligent equipment and industrial software solutions. R&D focuses on next-generation seat platforms, composite material structures, navigation system localization, and digital transformation through SIPDM product research management system.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through product sales of aircraft equipment and components, aviation maintenance services, and test equipment solutions. Revenue recognition occurs at point of delivery for most products, with some contracts involving provisional pricing and subsequent adjustment. The company also generates revenue from technical services, aircraft modification services, and aviation material trading.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic supplier of aircraft seats and cabin equipment, with strong competitive advantages in crash survival seat technology and cabin system solutions. It competes with international suppliers in the civil aviation market and holds significant market share in domestic defense applications. The company differentiates through rapid market response, comprehensive solutions, and airworthiness certification expertise.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company achieved 2023 revenue of 850.86 million yuan, representing 106.25% growth compared to 412.55 million yuan in 2022. Net profit attributable to shareholders was 113.48 million yuan in 2023 versus a loss of 45.82 million yuan in 2022. Total assets reached 1.59 billion yuan at year-end 2023, with 11% return on weighted average equity. The company demonstrates strong recovery and growth trajectory.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company's differentiation centers on comprehensive lifecycle solutions for aircraft, advanced crash survival and human factors technologies, rapid airworthiness certification capabilities, and integrated system-level offerings. The company emphasizes quality, reliability, and innovation in specialized aerospace applications, with particular strength in cabin systems, navigation equipment, and maintenance services. The company positions itself as a comprehensive supplier capable of providing both defense and civil aviation solutions.
